funds_data.description: Under normal market conditions, the fund invests in a diversified portfolio of debt and equity securities. The fund may invest up to 30% of its assets in equity index-linked notes, with respect to which interest payments are typically derived from the implied volatility of an equity index (e.g., the S&P 500 Index) and 10% of its assets in equity linked notes (ELNs).
